title: Run basic-auth test files with extra dependencies via uv --with
answers: how to run the auth server tests
which extra packages are needed for basic-auth tests
run fail-closed and workspace auth tests
body:
Command: uv run --with 'flask-wtf,httpx2,pyjwt' pytest tests/server/auth/test_fail_closed_flag.py tests/server/auth/test_authorization_coverage.py tests/server/auth/test_auth_workspace.py
The --with flag adds flask-wtf, httpx2 and pyjwt for this run without changing project dependencies; the PR reports these three files all pass with it.
Run tests/server/auth/test_auth.py the same way when exercising the secret create route end to end (the PR reports 11 such tests passing).
The auth tests cover the fail-closed backstop and workspace create validators, so run them after changing _authorized_outside_before_request or any validate_can_create_* validator.
applies: Local verification of basic-auth authorization changes in mlflow/server/auth; the extras list is as stated in the PR and may change.
says: Verify user permission rules and workspace access controls during local testing
Security tests for fail closed protection fail because required authentication libraries are missing
Test secret creation permissions and workspace validation after changing authorization rules
Make sure workspace creation permission checks properly enforce access restrictions
search: Run basic-auth authorization tests using uv run --with 'flask-wtf,httpx2,pyjwt' pytest to add transient dependencies without modifying project dependencies. This command executes tests/server/auth/test_fail_closed_flag.py, tests/server/auth/test_authorization_coverage.py, and tests/server/auth/test_auth_workspace.py, as well as tests/server/auth/test_auth.py for end-to-end secret create route testing. The suite covers the fail-closed backstop and workspace create validators, serving as verification when modifying _authorized_outside_before_request or validate_can_create_* validators. Guidance applies to local verification in mlflow/server/auth with an extras list subject to change.
